description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 1 mile to Beach Highlands Neighborhood Beach Access* 550 sqft of Porch Space w/ Swing! * 4 Bikes Included!* Infinity Pool (seasonally heated) overlooking Gulf and Topsail State Park * Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Tennis courts, Nature Trails, and Fitness Center * Close to Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *Please note: As part of ongoing neighborhood improvements, there is currently construction nearby. Despite the hustle and bustle outside, your comfort remains our top priority. Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to hosting you!**Vehicles including pickup trucks with raised camper tops or other raised enclosures or commercial vehicles (including all vehicles with commercial lettering or logos), boats, trailers, large trucks, campers, jet skis, motorcycles, All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs), or similar vehicles are NOT PERMITTED in the Cypress Dunes community.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!*Wristbands need to worn at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse and Guests will be charged $100 for each lost Wristband. Please note that HOA only allows 2 wristbands per bedroom. Depending on bedroom and sleep counts some guests may need to share wristband*When you head back from the beach, you will want to come home to Day is Done! This 3BR/3.5BA, NEW rental home is in the Cypress Dunes community, just off Hwy 30A. Day is Done has a bright, breezy feel with gorgeous hardwood flooring and beautiful french doors welcoming you to the spacious porch and balcony. The main living area is on the second floor and has high vaulted ceilings in an open floor concept and a gas fireplace. Create a home cooked meal in the professional-grade kitchen with lavish quartz countertops. With a king bed in the Master Suite, a king bed in the 1st guest room, and a queen bed w/ twin trundle in the 2nd guest room, this lovely beach home sleeps 7 guests comfortably- all bedrooms have en suite baths. Enjoy the sparkling community pool, get some fun exercise at the tennis courts, or take a leisurely stroll through the nature trails. Make Day is Done your next place to relax and unwind! Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18 mile bike path that stretches all the way to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!The Bed Setup: 1st Floor Guest Room: King Bed Guest Room: Queen Bed + Twin Trundle 2nd Floor Master Bedroom: King Bed Area Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
